headline: Yi-Chia Chen takes the ARC-AGI-3 lead

sections.text: Yi-Chia Chen took first place from Tufa Labs in the past day, reaching 59.17 (+3.40). Tufa Labs is now second at 56.52 (+0.63).
Chen is listed under their own name at the top of the public board. The lead change puts the 2026 ARC-AGI-3 standings into a new order, with Tufa Labs now chasing.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
